plugin.name: D-one Task Butler
plugin.description: Bridges D-one priority notes into NEKO: persona-fied reminders by priority — urge on p0, remind on p1, gentle on p2. Supports tone styles and the one-thing-at-a-time query.
entry.get_status.name: Get Bridge Status
entry.get_status.description: Get the D-one bridge plugin status: port, tone style, task count.
entry.get_tasks.name: Get Tasks
entry.get_tasks.description: Get all unfinished D-one tasks grouped by p0/p1/p2 priority. Use when the master asks 'what do I have to do' or 'today's plan'.
entry.get_top_task.name: Get Top Priority Task
entry.get_top_task.description: Get only the single most important task (one-thing-at-a-time). Use when the master asks 'what should I do now'.
entry.set_style.name: Switch Tone Style
entry.set_style.description: Switch reminder tone: neko_default (tsundere catgirl), calm (assistant), idol (cheerful).
entry.set_style.error.invalid_style: Unknown tone style; use neko_default, calm or idol
